ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, within a regular pentagon, $BE$ is a diagonal, $AF \perp BE$ intersects $CD$ at point $F$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle BAF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that the polygon ABCDE is a regular pentagon,\\
$\therefore \angle BAE=\frac{1}{5}\times \left(5-2\right)\times 180^\circ=108^\circ$,\\
$\because AF\perp BE$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAF=\frac{1}{2}\angle BAE=\frac{1}{2}\times 108^\circ=54^\circ$.\\
Hence, the answer is: $\boxed{54^\circ}$.
